entries.proposition: CaSc2TiO6 is a valid chemical formula with charge balance
entries.limitations: Formula-level analysis only; does not establish geometric feasibility
Unicode normalization only; no structural information

entries.proposition: Exact CaSc2TiO6 has been reported in literature
entries.result: No confirmed exact CaSc2TiO6 found in SearxNG results. Related parent structures found: Ca2ScTiO6, Sc2TiO5, CaSc2O4, Sc-doped CaTiO3
entries.limitations: SearxNG web search only; not a comprehensive literature review. Timeout/API error ≠ zero results.

entries.proposition: CaSc2TiO6 exists in public materials databases
entries.result: COD: checked_no_hit. AFLOW: checked_no_hit. NOMAD: checked_no_hit. OQMD: HTTP 502 (unavailable). Materials Project: accessible but API key missing.
entries.limitations: OQMD unavailable (HTTP 502). Materials Project requires API key. COD/AFLOW/NOMAD queries may not cover all entries.

entries.result: Charge balanced. All four exact balanced routes are mathematically available. Sc2TiO5 + CaO -> CaSc2TiO6 is exact. Sc4Ti2O10 + 2 CaO -> 2 CaSc2TiO6 is exact. CaSc2O4 + TiO2 -> CaSc2TiO6 is exact. CaTiO3 + Sc2O3 -> CaSc2TiO6 is exact.
entries.limitations: Formula-level analysis only. Does not establish geometric feasibility, stability, or synthesis feasibility.
supersedes: Previous claim that parent-derived construction is mathematically impossible

entries.proposition: Computational structure candidates for CaSc2TiO6 have been generated
entries.result: 19 candidates generated across phases 1B-1J. 0 DFT-ready. 2 pre-relaxation starting geometries. 13 downgraded. 4 reference phases. All exact-formula candidates have fatal distance violations or coordination failures.
entries.limitations: Hand-built coordinates only. No CSP, no ML structure prediction, no database-derived structures. All candidates failed geometric validation.

entries.proposition: Parent-motif construction from Sc-doped CaTiO3 clues
entries.result: SCATTI-PARENT-001 and SCATTI-PARENT-002 both rejected. Fatal Sc-O and O-O contacts. Hand-built coordinates insufficient.
entries.limitations: Hand-built coordinates only. The stoichiometric analysis was correct (formula matched) but geometric placement failed.

entries.result: max_force = 0.596 eV/Å after 50 steps (target: 0.2 eV/Å). Volume collapsed by 23.9%. Short O-O contact 1.483 Å. Sc-O coordination only 2 each. Classified as ml_relaxed_but_not_qe_ready.
entries.limitations: CHGNet ML relaxation only. Not DFT. Forces did not converge. Volume collapse suggests force field bias or over-relaxation.

entries.proposition: Competing phases for CaSc2TiO6 have been identified
entries.result: Reference phases created: CaO (fluorite), Sc2O3 (bixbyite), TiO2 (rutile), CaTiO3 (perovskite). No competing phase analysis performed.
entries.limitations: Reference phases created but no decomposition energy analysis performed.

entries.result: No phonon calculation performed. No molecular dynamics performed.

entries.limitations: Requires structure and stability evidence first.

entries.proposition: Evidence package for CaSc2TiO6 is complete
entries.result: Partial evidence package exists. Candidate definition, formula normalization, literature search (inconclusive), database crosscheck (inconclusive), chemical plausibility (supports), structure generation (negative), CHGNet relaxation (inconclusive).
entries.limitations: Multiple stages not started. No DFT. No CSP. No competing phase analysis. No dynamic stability. No property prediction. No synthesis feasibility.

entries.proposition: Publication draft for CaSc2TiO6 is ready
entries.result: No publication draft created. Claim boundary: CaSc2TiO6 remains an unvalidated computational candidate.

entries.proposition: Previous MP-parent experiment conclusion that Sc2TiO5 parent cannot scale to CaSc2TiO6
entries.result: Conclusion was invalid due to formula-unit scaling bug. Sc4Ti2O10 (Z=2) requires 2 CaO to reach 2 × CaSc2TiO6, not 1 CaO.
entries.limitations: Formula-level analysis only. Does not establish geometric feasibility.
supersedes: Previous claim that parent-derived construction is impossible

contradictions.description: Previous MP-parent experiment concluded Sc2TiO5 parent cannot scale to CaSc2TiO6. Stoichiometric analysis shows exact balanced route exists: Sc4Ti2O10 + 2 CaO -> 2 CaSc2TiO6.
contradictions.resolution: Formula-unit scaling bug. Parent cell (Sc4Ti2O10) has Z=2. Previous code added 1 CaO instead of 2 CaO.
